keyword: where to watch the artemis 2 landing

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew is set to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'waters off San Diego' 'Pacific Ocean'; R2: '40 to 50 miles off the coast of San Diego'; R3: 'off the coast of San Diego'; R4: 'off the coast of California'; R5: 'off the coast of San Diego, California'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state the splashdown location as Pacific Ocean off San Diego, California.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew is set to splash down on Friday, April 10, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Floating in the Pacific Ocean on Friday'; R2: 'April 10, 2026'; R3: 'April 1 ... Flight Day 10'; R4: 'April 10, 2026'; R5: 'Friday, April 10'; R6: 'April 10, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: All references confirm the splashdown date as Friday, April 10, 2026.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew is set to splash down at approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT.

verifications.reasoning: References directly state targeted splashdown at 8:07 p.m. EDT/ET.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew is set to splash down at 5:07 p.m. PDT.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.claim: Live coverage of the re-entry and landing begins at 6:30 p.m. EDT on NASA+, the NASA app, and YouTube.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Watch live return coverage on NASA+ ... starting at 6:30 p.m.'; R5: 'begin at 6:30 p.m. ET on YouTube and ... NASA+'; R6: '6:30 pm NASA’s Artemis II Crew Comes Home (Official Broadcast)'; R7: 'Live coverage begins at 6:30 p.m. EDT'
verifications.reasoning: References confirm coverage start at 6:30 p.m. EDT on NASA+, YouTube; NASA app aligns with NASA+.

verifications.claim: Live coverage starts at 3:30 p.m. PDT.

verifications.reasoning: Coverage start stated as 6:30 p.m. EDT (equivalent to 3:30 p.m. PDT), but PDT time not explicitly mentioned for coverage.

verifications.claim: Official NASA live stream coverage begins at 6:30 p.m. EDT on Friday, April 10, 2026.

verifications.reasoning: Directly supported with date, time, and official NASA streams.
